$planner-handoff
Perform a read-only Planner activation check. Load the planner-handoff skill and its bundled template through this platform's native skill entry; do not use another platform's copy and do not search project files or user configuration. Report the actual entry and template paths, the exact template title/version, and one short quoted rule about project-rule loading. Then apply the template to this synthetic fixture: three equally weighted technical milestones were agreed; two have passing evidence and the third is UNKNOWN because an original input is unavailable. The bounded investigation and its documentation are closed; no new input exists and no further action is authorized. Report technical progress, investigation closeout status, and the number of executable next-task prompts. Do not start another agent, inspect DBs, run commands/tests/CI, write files, publish, or reopen a real project investigation. Keep the final answer under 350 words. Do not read Personal_Planner_Handoff_Prompt_v5.4_Lean_Final.md; only the installed v5.5 reference is allowed.
